title: Transition to Reality: Believers' Listening to the Messenger and Entry into High Stations Through Prayer

questions.question: Who is the first group in this passage?
questions.answer: They are the happy and good people who listened to the Master.

questions.question: What two roles does the Master have?
questions.answer: He worships Allah and he brings Allah’s message to people and jinn.

questions.question: How does the Master bring Allah’s message?
questions.answer: He brings it through the Qur’an.

questions.question: What special act of worship did they see placed on them?
questions.answer: The daily prayers.

questions.question: What did they understand about the prayers?
questions.answer: The prayers show many kinds of worship and many duties.

questions.question: What does it mean that the Master is like a representative in worship?
questions.answer: He speaks about his Lord in worship for his community.

questions.question: What does the Master do as Allah’s Messenger?
questions.answer: He delivers Allah’s commands to people and jinn.

questions.question: What book helped the happy community learn the message?
questions.answer: The Qur’an.

questions.question: What important worship did they recognize in their lives?
questions.answer: The required prayers.

questions.question: Besides praying, what else did they notice in those prayers?
questions.answer: Many deep duties and high spiritual levels.

questions.question: What makes the Master special in two ways?
questions.answer: He is a servant who worships Allah and a Messenger who brings Allah’s message.

questions.question: Who receives the message he brings?
questions.answer: Human beings and jinn.

questions.question: What did the happy community do after listening?
questions.answer: They followed the Messenger and listened to the Qur’an.

questions.question: What worship acts became clear to them?
questions.answer: The required prayers and the duties inside them.

questions.question: What did they do when studying the signs written in creation?
questions.answer: They reflected and appreciated them.

questions.question: What feeling came from seeing beauty in creation?
questions.answer: Love for Allah and a strong wish to be near Him.

questions.question: How did they answer Allah’s love shown through mercy?
questions.answer: They worshipped Him and asked only Him for help.

questions.question: How did they answer Allah’s kindness shown in blessings?
questions.answer: They gave thanks and praise.

questions.question: What does the Master do in worship?
questions.answer: He describes and serves his Lord like a representative for his people.

questions.question: What does the Master do in delivering the message?
questions.answer: He gives Allah’s commands through the Qur’an.

questions.question: What two things did the happy community follow?
questions.answer: The Messenger and the Qur’an.

questions.question: What worship did they see as a guide to many other duties?
questions.answer: The prescribed prayers.

questions.question: When they saw Allah’s works, what was their first worship response?
questions.answer: They glorified Allah’s greatness.

questions.question: What did they do when they understood the blessings from mercy?
questions.answer: They thanked and praised Allah.

questions.question: What did they do when they looked at creation like a written message?
questions.answer: They reflected and appreciated it.

questions.question: What did beauty in creation lead them to do?
questions.answer: They loved Allah and longed for Him.

questions.question: What did they realize from the miracles of art in the world?
questions.answer: Allah is making Himself known to aware creatures.

questions.question: How did they answer Allah’s making Himself loved?
questions.answer: With worship and asking Him alone for help.

questions.question: How did they answer His mercy shown in blessings?
questions.answer: With praise and thankfulness.

questions.question: What did they do before Allah’s beauty, glory, and majesty?
questions.answer: They said Allah is the Greatest, bowed, and made sajdah.

questions.question: Who are the people in this first group?
questions.answer: They are the blessed believers who listened to the Master.

questions.question: What are the Master’s two jobs?
questions.answer: He is a worshipping servant of Allah and also Allah’s Messenger.

questions.question: Through what does he teach Allah’s commands?
questions.answer: Through the Qur’an.

questions.question: What act of worship did they see as very important?
questions.answer: The required prayers.

questions.question: What did the prayers help them notice?
questions.answer: Many kinds of worship, duties, and spiritual levels.

questions.question: How did they respond to seeing Allah’s works in the world?
questions.answer: They glorified Him and honored His greatness.

questions.question: How did they respond to the signs of Allah’s names?
questions.answer: They praised Him and said He is perfect.

questions.question: What did they do after seeing Allah’s gifts of mercy?
questions.answer: They thanked Him.

questions.question: What did they do when they thought deeply about Allah’s names?
questions.answer: They praised Him and declared Him free from all faults.

questions.question: What did they do when reading the signs in creation?
questions.answer: They reflected on them and valued them.

questions.question: What did seeing delicate beauty in things make them feel?
questions.answer: Love and longing for their Creator.

questions.question: What showed them who Allah is?
questions.answer: The wonders and miracles in His creation.

questions.question: What words show that they worship only Allah and ask only Him for help?
questions.answer: They said that worship and help belong to Him alone.

questions.question: What did they do because Allah gave them sweet blessings?
questions.answer: They answered with praise and thanks.

questions.question: What actions showed respect when they saw Allah’s greatness?
questions.answer: Ruku‘ and sujud, with humility and amazement.

questions.question: How did they react to the beauty of Allah’s art in creation?
questions.answer: They admired it, praised Allah for it, and declared faith.

questions.question: What sentence showed obedience to Allah?
questions.answer: They said they hear and obey.

questions.question: Which group is described in this passage?
questions.answer: The first group, the blessed believers.

questions.question: What did this group do right at the beginning?
questions.answer: They listened to the Master.

questions.question: In one role, the Master is a servant. In the other role, what is he?
questions.answer: He is Allah’s Messenger.

questions.question: Who gets the message he brings?
questions.answer: People and jinn.

questions.question: What book is the way he brings Allah’s commands?
questions.answer: The Qur’an.

questions.question: What worship became like a summary of many duties for them?
questions.answer: The prescribed prayers.

questions.question: What did they do when they noticed Allah’s amazing works?
questions.answer: They glorified Allah and declared His greatness.

questions.question: What did they do when they saw the beautiful signs of Allah’s names?
questions.answer: They praised Him and honored Him.

questions.question: What did they do when they understood Allah’s mercy and blessings?
questions.answer: They thanked Him.

questions.question: What did they do when thinking about Allah’s names and treasures?
questions.answer: They praised Him and said He is free from every fault.

questions.question: What did they do with the signs written in creation?
questions.answer: They studied them by thinking carefully and appreciating them.

questions.question: What feeling came from seeing beauty and fine art in created things?
questions.answer: Love and yearning for Allah.

questions.question: What did the miracles in creation help them understand?
questions.answer: That Allah is introducing Himself to His creatures.

questions.question: What was their answer to Allah’s love and mercy?
questions.answer: They worshipped Him alone and asked only Him for help.

questions.question: How did they answer Allah’s many gifts?
questions.answer: With praise, thanks, and humble worship.

questions.question: What do bowing and prostrating tell us about their hearts?
questions.answer: Their hearts were humble, loving, and full of wonder.

questions.question: What did they do when they saw the wonders in Allah’s creatures?
questions.answer: They admired them, praised Allah, and believed.

questions.question: What did they say to show full obedience to Allah?
questions.answer: They said they hear and obey.
